title: Drive and Growl
brief: Saturation isn't just "make it louder and dirtier" -- moved over time, it's a growl. Patch a VCO (Saw Shape, Octave around -2) into a Drive module's "In" jack, and the Drive's "Out" into the Output's "In". Add an LFO and patch its "Out" into the Drive's "CV" jack -- that's the drive-amount input. Turn the Drive's Amt knob up to around 4-6: now the LFO is sweeping how hard the signal is driven, not just its pitch or its filter. Turn the LFO's Rate up past 3 Hz or so -- slow enough to hear as motion, fast enough to sound like a throat, not a wobble.
